As part of the training in becoming a [[mesmer]], [[Lady Althea]] tasks you with eliminating a massive [[Rogue Bull|rogue bull]] that is terrorizing a local [[Lakeside County|watering hole]] and threatening the patrons of her beloved theatre.

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = pre
| test = y
| profession = mesmer
| primary = y
| secondary = n
}}

===Objectives===
* Kill the rogue bull that is threatening Althea's theatre.
* Return to Lady Althea for your reward.

===Early benefits===
* Lady Althea will give you the following skills upon taking the quest:
** {{skill icon|Conjure Phantasm}}
** {{skill icon|Ether Feast}}
** {{skill icon|Imagined Burden}}

===Reward===
* 250 [[Experience]]

===Environmental changes===
* Upon completing the quest, even before accepting the reward, the Rogue Bull will no longer spawn at the watering hole. Instead, [[Old Mac]] will appear near the gate and offer [[The Rogue's Replacement]] after having a word with Althea.
** This change requires that all members of the party have completed the quest.

==Walkthrough==
Head roughly southwest from Lady Althea towards the pool of water to find the Rogue Bull. As a level 5 beast, the bull boasts a high [[armor rating]] that blunts standard physical attacks and can deal a significant amount of damage.

Begin the encounter by casting [[Imagined Burden]] to severely cripple the bull's movement speed. Follow up with [[Conjure Phantasm]] to apply steady health degeneration, bypassing its armor. Also be wary of its [[Bull's Charge]], with which it can quickly close the gap and inflict a [[knock down]], particularly if you are attempting to flee. Once the bull is dead, return to Lady Althea for your reward.

===Skill recommendations===
* Skills which ignore armor, such as [[Bane Signet]], [[Banish]] or [[Empathy]]
* Health degeneration skills, such as [[Conjure Phantasm]] or [[Sever Artery]]
* Healing skills, such as [[Orison of Healing]] or [[Troll Unguent]]
